Welcome to Mama Shack ⭐️ 

About Us

Mama Shack is a brand for parents that want practical baby essentials where style and design has not been sacrificed. Our aim is to design quality products using our own signature prints to give a contemporary rethink to your everyday baby products. Baby changing mats are one of the most used products in your nursery yet the design has always been overlooked. Our collection is not only practical but works around your modern home decor.

We've also designed a collection of modern baby essentials in our playful prints. Whether you are planning your newborns nursery, starting babies weaning journey or looking for design lead baby essentials we have you covered!

Our Story 

After a long search for a baby shower gift that complimented my best friends home interior, that was practical yet trend led the idea to design and print my own changing mat evolved.

My print and design background allowed me to start creating personalised changing mats for friends and family. Soon after I launched my website and that’s how Mama Shack (the nickname of my friend who received my first changing mat) was born.

Since then I have expanded our product line to include a variety of different changing mats that feature meticulously designed, trend led patterns to suit any room in the home. We also sell our own range of baby essentials to compliment our designs, which are designed exclusively in house and are British made. 

Work With Us

  • Receive up to 10% commission rate on all confirmed sales. 
  • Get early access to exclusive promotional offers.
  • Regular updates on  the latest news and products.

Join Mama Shack today and start earning commission.

Any questions please get in touch

Many Thanks

Daniella @ Mama Shack
